_comment: #460 EYE-GATE (user ruling 2026-08-14: eye-gates ride a prepared save). The [Bone Dart] / [Deathbolt] recolour changed TWO ALREADY-SHIPPED player spells from flame-orange to grave-green, and no canonical can field it: WICombatAI defaults the PC's empty `ai` to the melee profile, so autoplay STRUCTURALLY cannot cast. This save is the only way a human sees a PC death-cast. warrior 11 + necromancer 10 holds bone_dart (necromancer L1) and deathbolt (L3) with enough body to survive several rounds; both are hotbarred. Parked one cell west of crypt_lich_mouth (17,11) facing east — the encounter is interact-only, so the fight starts when you press interact and not before. The Lich casts the SAME two spells back, so PC-cast and enemy-cast grave-green are judgeable in one fight. DO NOT SLEEP in this state: warrior 11 + necromancer 10 is the [Deathknight] consolidation pair and the sleep beat would fire it, retiring the parents mid-read.
